criticalRisks.title: AI API Keys Exposed in Client Bundle
criticalRisks.description: EXPO_PUBLIC_GROK_API_KEY, EXPO_PUBLIC_GROQ_API_KEY, and EXPO_PUBLIC_OPENROUTER_API_KEY are embedded in the JavaScript bundle via Expo's public env vars. Any user can extract these keys from the APK/IPA.
criticalRisks.impact: API key theft, unlimited billing, data exfiltration via attacker-controlled prompts
criticalRisks.mitigation: Move AI calls to a backend proxy. Rate-limit per user on server side. Use short-lived tokens.

highRisks.title: Health Connect Disabled on Android
highRisks.description: react-native-health-connect is installed but ff_health_sync feature flag is false. Android users have no health data integration.
highRisks.impact: Cannot sync steps, heart rate, sleep from Google Health on Android. iOS HealthKit works.
highRisks.mitigation: Enable Health Connect with proper permissions flow and data consent.

highRisks.title: 20+ Silent .catch(() => {}) Blocks
highRisks.description: At least 20 empty catch blocks across the codebase silently swallow errors, preventing debugging and crash reporting.
highRisks.impact: Errors in production invisible. User-facing failures with no diagnostic trail.
highRisks.mitigation: Replace with .catch(e => logger.warn(...)) minimum. Add Sentry breadcrumbs for critical paths.

highRisks.title: No Push Notification System
highRisks.description: No push notification infrastructure exists. No workout reminders, streak alerts, trial expiry warnings, or re-engagement notifications.
highRisks.impact: 30-day retention drops substantially without push re-engagement. Trial conversion suffers.
highRisks.mitigation: Implement expo-notifications with local scheduling for workout reminders and streak preservation.

highRisks.title: No Backend Server
highRisks.description: Entire app is client-only. No server for: AI proxy, cross-device sync, user accounts, push notifications, analytics aggregation, or subscription webhook verification.
highRisks.impact: Limits product scalability. AI keys exposed. No cross-device experience. No server-side receipt validation.
highRisks.mitigation: Build minimal API: AI proxy + webhook receiver + user sync. Phase 10+ roadmap.

highRisks.title: Deprecated Modules Still Imported
highRisks.description: 5 deprecated modules still imported by active code: socialLayerService, aiWorkoutService, TransformerRuntime, MindSessionEngine, DistanceEngine.
highRisks.impact: Bundle bloat (TransformerRuntime alone is 48MB). Potential runtime errors from stale code paths.
highRisks.mitigation: Remove all deprecated imports. Delete unused files. Tree-shaking may help TransformerRuntime but cannot be relied upon.

mediumRisks.title: 58 react-hooks/exhaustive-deps Violations
mediumRisks.description: ESLint reports 58 missing dependencies in useEffect/useCallback/useMemo across the codebase. Ratcheted at 804 total warnings.
mediumRisks.impact: Stale closures, missed re-renders, subtle state bugs that manifest intermittently.
mediumRisks.mitigation: Fix dependencies systematically. Add missing deps or convert to refs. Target: reduce to 0.

mediumRisks.title: FitMind Tables Still in Schema
mediumRisks.description: 6 FitMind tables (fitmind_documents, fitmind_reading_sessions, fitmind_annotations, fitmind_flashcards, fitmind_reading_goals, fitmind_reading_streaks) exist in schema v20 but the module is deprecated.
mediumRisks.impact: Wasted storage, migration overhead, confusion for maintainers. ~2KB overhead per empty table.
mediumRisks.mitigation: Drop tables in schema v21 migration after confirming no residual references.

mediumRisks.title: schema.ts Monolith (1700 lines)
mediumRisks.description: All 20 migration versions in a single file. Hard to review, easy to introduce merge conflicts.
mediumRisks.impact: Maintainability risk. Any schema change touches the same 1700-line file.
mediumRisks.mitigation: Split migrations into per-version files. Keep combined schema as reference only.

mediumRisks.title: No E2E Test Suite
mediumRisks.description: No end-to-end tests. 807 unit/integration tests exist but no Detox, Maestro, or Appium tests.
mediumRisks.impact: UI regressions, navigation bugs, and integration failures caught only in manual QA.
mediumRisks.mitigation: Add Maestro flows for: onboarding, workout lifecycle, subscription paywall, profile.

mediumRisks.title: Dual Workout Engine (v1 + v2 Coexistence)
mediumRisks.description: workoutGenerator.ts (v1) coexists with src/engines/workout/ (v2) via legacyAdapter.ts. Two code paths for the same domain.
mediumRisks.impact: Maintenance burden. Bug fixes may need to be applied in two places. Adapter adds indirection.
mediumRisks.mitigation: Complete v2 migration. Remove v1 generator. Eliminate adapter.

mediumRisks.title: Cloud Backup Service Placeholder
mediumRisks.description: cloudBackupService.ts references EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL which doesn't exist. Cloud backup is non-functional.
mediumRisks.impact: Profile backup is local-only. Device loss = data loss.
mediumRisks.mitigation: Implement cloud backup endpoint or use secure cloud storage (S3/GCS with signed URLs).

lowRisks.title: Platform Stub Files
lowRisks.description: 3 files in src/platform/ (phase8, phase9, phase10) are empty stubs with no implementation.
lowRisks.mitigation: Delete stubs or convert to roadmap documentation.

lowRisks.title: Legal Text English-Only
lowRisks.description: privacy-policy.tsx and terms-of-service.tsx contain English-only legal text despite 15-language UI support.
lowRisks.impact: Compliance risk in non-English markets. Google Play may flag for certain regions.
lowRisks.mitigation: Translate legal text for top 5 markets or use language-adaptive links.

lowRisks.title: AI Template Responses English-Only
lowRisks.description: DualAIEngine template responses (fallback when API is unavailable) are in English only.
lowRisks.impact: Offline AI coaching is English-only even for non-English users.
lowRisks.mitigation: Localize top 20 template responses via translations.ts.
